issues.location: transitivity proof for the set of order types
issues.finding: The proof says B is a subset of the relation R, although B is the underlying subset of A used to form an element of C.
issues.proposed_resolution: Use B subseteq A at this point of the order-type argument.

issues.location: relation pulled across a hypothetical injection from alpha to A
issues.finding: The set-builder reuses the fixed ordinal alpha as a bound variable and leaves beta unbounded, so it does not correctly define the transported well-order on the range of f.
issues.proposed_resolution: Use fresh xi,zeta ranging over alpha and include xi in zeta as the relation condition.

issues.location: forward implication from Well-Ordering to cardinal comparability
issues.finding: The isomorphism functions from alpha and beta are displayed with ordered structures as codomains, rather than their underlying sets A and B.
issues.proposed_resolution: Display f:alpha to A and g:beta to B while retaining the stated ordered-structure isomorphisms.

issues.location: closing example of the infinite-cardinal maximum law
issues.finding: The source nests a cardinal-equality macro inside another equality with M, producing a malformed assertion. The intended claim compares both the disjoint sum and product with the larger of A and B.
issues.proposed_resolution: State the two equations cardeq(A disjointsum B,M) and cardeq(A times B,M) separately, as a general law unavailable without Choice.

translation_treatment: The target repairs the Hartogs proof's underlying-set inclusion and transported relation, the isomorphism codomains, and the closing two-equation claim. The frozen source remains unchanged.
